clips.title: Individual cell painting
clips.description: Blue cells are painted onto a red board; the surrounding cells retain their colour.

clips.title: Manual mode and Fill All
clips.description: The stored manual cells are visible, then Fill All turns the full matrix red. Pending editor changes near the end are not represented as applied changes.

clips.title: Animated background presets
clips.description: Rainbow, Center ripple and Cycle are selected with their changing matrix output visible.

clips.title: Reactive Ripple and Flash
clips.description: Pad interactions produce expanding colour patterns and a whole-board white flash.

clips.title: Background and reactive speed
clips.description: The layer-settings sliders are adjusted alongside the live matrix.

clips.title: Ripple shape and timing
clips.description: Ring width and timing controls are adjusted while ripple patterns remain visible.

clips.title: TOP input and control modes
clips.description: IMAGE / TOP supplies a multicolour pattern, followed by Add and Manual mode changes.
